title: The totient divisor formula for translation orbits
statement: For every nonzero natural number N, let Γ₀(N) be the subgroup of SL₂(ℤ) whose bottom-left entry is zero modulo N, and let Q=SL₂(ℤ)/Γ₀(N) with left multiplication. Put T=((1,1),(0,1)). The number of orbits on Q of the subgroup {Tⁿ:n∈ℤ} is ∑_{d∣N}φ(gcd(d,N/d)), where φ is Euler’s totient; this is ModularCurve.cuspCount N.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], let Q := (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) ⧸ CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 N; Nat.card (Quotient (MulAction.orbitRel (Subgroup.zpowers ModularGroup.T) Q)) = ModularCurve.cuspCount N
